messages:
Nora (Design): quick thought 16 - should the trace export action live inline on the request drilldown or only in the top toolbar? leaning inline because people want to grab a single-span JSON when investigating.
Ben (Frontend): inline is more discoverable. small concern: adding an export menu to every span could bloat DOM. we should lazy-render the menu and reuse a portal for the modal.
Carla (Product): support reported users copy/paste the whole stacktrace into tickets. an "Export span JSON" + "Export minimal trace (ids + metadata)" option would be great. also we should surface a short CTA: "Copy correlation ID" next to stackframes.
Jin (Eng Runtime): server constraints: exports could leak sensitive payloads. we'll need server-side redaction rules and an allowlist/denylist. also rate-limit exports per trace to avoid abuse.
Rhea (A11y): accessibility notes: export menu should be a real menu button (`aria-haspopup="menu"`) with visible focus. the modal needs `role="dialog"` and `aria-modal="true"`. ensure focus returns to the triggering control after close.
Omar (Support): add a tiny helper copy label that explains correlation ids: "Use this ID when you file a ticket or search logs." makes it easier for non devs.
Ben (Frontend): for keyboard: open menu with Enter/Space, navigate items with Arrow keys, activate with Enter. also add a keyboard shortcut when a trace is focused: `Shift+C` to copy correlation id (opt-in).
Rhea (A11y): quick nit: do NOT add keyboard shortcuts that conflict with browser defaults. also announce success with an `aria-live="polite"` message when copy/export succeeds.
Jin (Eng Runtime): export formats: `full-json`, `minimal-json`, `curl` (presigned). presigned links should expire quickly. we'll add a server flag to redact `request.body` unless `allow_full_export` is set on the org.
Nora (Design): UI copy options: copy button should read "Copy correlation ID" not just "Copy". export action menu item should be explicit: "Export span (JSON)" / "Export minimal trace" / "Open in logs".
Carla (Product): metrics: track `ui.export.clicked` with format, user_role, and whether redaction was applied. for copy: `ui.copy.correlation_id`. privacy mindful.
Ben (Frontend): small prototype CSS for the inline menu: `.span-actions { display:inline-flex; gap:8px; align-items:center; } .export-menu { min-width:180px; }`
OpsBot: ticket created #INFR-4282 "Inline trace export & redaction controls" assigned to @Jin.
Rhea (A11y): also check color contrast for the small helper text under the correlation id. if it's < 14px ensure 4.5:1 contrast or bump size.
Jin (Eng Runtime): perf note: generating full-json for huge traces will be deferred to a background job, return a presigned URL when ready. immediate small exports should be synchronous.
Omar (Support): request: add an "Include surrounding 2 requests" toggle on minimal export for easier debugging.
Nora (Design): good idea, we'll add that toggle in the modal UI as an advanced option.
Carla (Product): action items pls.
Nora (Design): Action items:
- Ben: build keyboard-accessible inline export menu prototype (lazy mount + portal) and include copy correlation id flow. Demo by Fri.
- Jin: design server redaction flow, rate limits, and background-export job; doc the presign TTLs.
- Rhea: produce an a11y checklist for the menu/modal (roles, focus, aria-live, contrast).
- Omar: draft support blurb explaining what minimal vs full export contains and guidance for customers.
- Carla: add analytics events spec and privacy guardrails.
Nora (Design): tagging folks: @Ben @Jin @Rhea @Omar @Carla
Ben (Frontend): will open a PR to `feature/inline-export` and drop a demo link in thread.
Jin (Eng Runtime): noted, I'll post infra constraints and an endpoint sketch in thread by EOD.
Rhea (A11y): happy to review the demo.
Omar (Support): will draft the blurb and link examples.
Carla (Product): thanks team  - feels like a tangible improvement for investigation UX.
OpsBot: related deploy: backend/redaction v1 -> staging queued for 2024-06-18 09:00 UTC
Nora (Design): closing loop after demo and infra check. :sparkles:
